verdicts.quote: “HighLevel currently supports two types of authorization: • Private Integration Token • OAuth 2.0 Flow … You should use OAuth 2.0 Flow if: You’re developing a full-scale integration intended for public use.”
verdicts.reason: Value: OAuth2. OAuth2 is the primary method for multi-tenant/public integrations per vendor guidance.

verdicts.quote: “You do not need to complete a manual developer signup form.”
verdicts.reason: Value: self_serve_free. Developer credentials are self‑serve; sandbox/testing available without production accounts.

verdicts.quote: “The APIs support contacts, conversations, calendars, workflows, payments, webhooks, and more.”
verdicts.reason: Value: broad. Docs show many product areas and CRUD endpoints/scopes across modules.

verdicts.quote: “ChatGPT | The official HighLevel app in ChatGPT”
verdicts.reason: Value: official. HighLevel publishes and maintains an official MCP server and apps for AI clients.

verdicts.quote: “All public apps must undergo a review process by the HighLevel marketplace team before they can be installed and used by customers.”
verdicts.reason: Value: ready_with_caveats. API and creds are available now; public distribution requires marketplace review and v2 rate limits apply.
